tour.360.1.body.en: The tour has opened the Guest Bedroom's survey prep, in the Survey phase; everything goes back at the end. Tap 360 to look round the whole room.

tour.360.2.body.en: Drag the picture to turn round the room, and pinch to zoom. Start the drag on bare wall: a drag that starts on a mark moves that mark instead.

tour.360.3.body.en: The 360 has no step strip: it marks on every bounded surface at once, with every type.

tour.360.4.body.en: The palette works as it does on a surface, and More ▸ holds every type of every surface.

tour.360.5.body.en: Tap Electric. In the 360 a type stays picked just as it does on a surface.

tour.360.6.body.en: The tour has turned the 360 to the front wall. For practice, tap the bare wall in the lit part, below the window: the point lands on the surface under your finger, FE2 on the front wall. A type only goes where it can be: a Window tapped on the floor is refused.

tour.360.7.body.en: A surface tab leaves the 360 and goes back to the step that surface was on.

tour.360.line.en: The 360 tab: look round the room and mark straight onto any bounded surface.

tour.existing.1.body.en: The tour has opened the Guest Bedroom's 360 on the front wall, in the Survey phase; everything goes back at the end. The palette: Select, Tape, Line, Chain, the three commonest types here, and More ▸.

tour.existing.10.body.en: Tap a row, then type the laser figure in its mm box; Δ shows how far the photo was off. Readings are taken in the Survey phase only.

tour.existing.11.body.en: With the Leica D2 switched on, tap D2 and its reading lands in the active row. The tour does not press it.

tour.existing.12.body.en: Show switches between the photo's estimates (≈ Photo), the laser readings (Measured) and both together.

tour.existing.13.body.en: Tap the padlock once a mark is measured: a locked mark cannot be moved or deleted by a stray finger. Tap it again to unlock.

tour.existing.2.body.en: Tap Electric, the point for a switch board or a socket. A type stays picked, so every tap on the photo places one more.

tour.existing.3.body.en: The chip says what you are placing. In the Survey phase every mark is born Existing, something already in the room, so the chip needs no more words.

tour.existing.4.body.en: For practice, tap the bare wall in the lit part; on site you tap where the item really is. The mark gets a code: F for the front wall, E for electric, then a number. FE1 is already here, so yours is FE2. A tap on a mark that is already there, like the window FW1, selects it instead of placing a second.

tour.existing.5.body.en: Tap Select when you are done. Forgetting it is the commonest cause of duplicate marks.

tour.existing.6.body.en: Tap More ▸ for every other type this surface can have.

tour.existing.7.body.en: The types are grouped by trade: Civil, Doors & windows, Electrical, Plumbing and the rest. Pick one and place it the same way.

tour.existing.8.body.en: The tour has closed More ▸ and selected FW1, the window already there. This row nudges it, locks it or deletes it; its code opens the Mark sheet.

tour.existing.9.body.en: In 3 · List each mark has a chip with its readings done, like 0/5. Tap a chip to work on that mark.

tour.existing.line.en: The palette, a type, placing a mark on bare wall, More ▸ and its trade rows, then its readings, the D2 and the lock.

tour.phases.1.body.en: The tour has opened Demo flat interiors, the practice project; everything goes back at the end. This strip is its phase: Survey, Wish list, Vendor review, Estimation.

tour.phases.10.body.en: The tour has opened the Guest Bedroom's 360. The band at the top shows the phase here too, and what it lets you do.

tour.phases.2.body.en: In Survey you capture the room, bound its walls, mark what is already there and take the laser readings. The line under the strip always says what the current phase is for.

tour.phases.3.body.en: Tap Wish list. A move forward happens at once, with no question.

tour.phases.4.body.en: From the Wish list phase on, the project shows the Wish list chip: the services the client asks for. In Survey it is hidden.

tour.phases.5.body.en: A phase move also moves the quote stage on this line. On the phone the move goes to the office (S5); the prototype sends nothing.

tour.phases.6.body.en: Vendor review turns the client's wishes into trades and vendor packs. A mark placed in this phase is born Vendor added.

tour.phases.7.body.en: Estimation is the hand-off: nothing new is marked and the wish list is read-only. Once the quote is Estimated this strip folds into a ✓ chip, and from then on the work stage (PROJECT IS AT) moves the project.

tour.phases.8.body.en: Tap Survey. A move back is never silent: the app asks before it changes the phase.

tour.phases.9.body.en: Keep stays in Wish list; Move back returns the project to Survey. Tap either one.

tour.phases.line.en: The project's four phases, what each one shows, and how a move forward or back works.

tour.plan.1.body.en: The tour has opened Demo flat interiors and puts the layout back at the end. The Floor plan tile arranges the project's surveyed rooms on one plan: tap it.

tour.plan.2.body.en: Each surveyed room is drawn to its laser sizes, with its doors and windows. Drag Guest Bedroom to move it.

tour.plan.3.body.en: A tap on a room selects it and shows ↻ 90°. Tap it to turn the room a quarter turn.

tour.plan.4.body.en: Let a room go within 150 mm of another and their walls snap edge to edge. The demo has one surveyed room, so there is nothing to snap to yet.

tour.plan.5.body.en: Two fingers zoom and one finger on the paper pans. Fit brings every room back into view.

tour.plan.6.body.en: Reset layout puts every room back in its starting row, after asking. The tour does not press it.

tour.plan.line.en: Arrange the project's surveyed rooms on one plan: drag, turn 90°, and let the edges snap.

tour.survey.1.body.en: The tour has opened Clients and uses Demo Client, the practice data, in the Survey phase; everything goes back at the end. Tap Demo Client.

tour.survey.10.body.en: Tap 2 · Mark. Here you place the doors, windows and points on the surface; the Mark existing items tour shows how.

tour.survey.11.body.en: Tap 3 · List: every mark with the photo's estimate, the laser reading and the difference.

tour.survey.12.body.en: ✓ Save turns gold once all six surfaces are bounded, and saves the survey into the room folder. Your work is kept as you go anyway. The tour does not press it.

tour.survey.2.body.en: A client has one or more sites: a flat, a bungalow or an office. Tap Demo Site, Pune.

tour.survey.3.body.en: A site holds its projects, each with its own rooms and phase. Tap Demo flat interiors.

tour.survey.4.body.en: Rooms with photos come first, with their count. Tap Guest Bedroom.

tour.survey.5.body.en: On site, Capture 360 takes a new 360 of the room, after its three laser sizes. The tour does not press it: it uses the 360 already taken here.

tour.survey.6.body.en: Each kept 360 has its tile; the line under it says how far its survey prep got. Tap the picture to open survey prep.

tour.survey.7.body.en: Each surface gets four lines: the floor and ceiling lines and the two corners. Drag each one onto the real edge in the photo; a line counts once you have touched it.

tour.survey.8.body.en: Each line has its row here, with nudge buttons for the last few millimetres and ↺ ↻ to turn it.

tour.survey.9.body.en: Bound all six: four walls, the floor and the ceiling. A tab shows ✓ once its lines are set; this practice room is done already.

tour.survey.line.en: From Clients to a room's 360, then its three steps, 1 · Lines, 2 · Mark, 3 · List, and ✓ Save.

tour.vendor.1.body.en: The tour has opened Demo flat interiors in Wish list, with two practice wishes on the Guest Bedroom's front wall; everything goes back at the end. Tap Vendor review: the wishes go to the vendors and the quote stage becomes Vendor quoted.

tour.vendor.10.body.en: Tap ⇪ Export. In Vendor review the Export sheet offers the vendor's own pack.

tour.vendor.11.body.en: The tour has picked Doors & windows: this pack carries only that trade's marks, FW1 among them, never the electric points, the office notes or the client's name. PDF, PNG or JPEG sets the file type. The tour does not save it.

tour.vendor.11.title.en: Their trades, as PDF or image

tour.vendor.12.body.en: The tour has opened the Guest Bedroom 360's details. In the quote journey its STG line is locked until the quote is Estimated; then the work stage takes over. Done puts everything back.

tour.vendor.2.body.en: VENDOR PACKS groups the wishes by trade: the window FW1 goes to Doors & windows, the electric point FE1 to Electrical. Each number counts the wishes still with the vendor.

tour.vendor.3.body.en: Doors & win. makes the window vendor's pack: that trade's marks only, no office notes, no client name. The tour does not open it here; survey prep's Export does the same later in this tour.

tour.vendor.4.body.en: The tour has opened the Guest Bedroom's 360 in Vendor review. Only this phase has the Trade chip, All ▾: pick a trade and survey prep shows just that vendor's marks.

tour.vendor.5.body.en: The tour has picked Electric. In this phase the chip adds as Vendor added: what a vendor finds is needed on site, beyond the client's wishes.

tour.vendor.6.body.en: For practice, tap the bare wall in the lit part: the electrician wants a new point there. FE2 is born Vendor added and carries the V+ badge. The tour takes it away at the end.

tour.vendor.7.body.en: In 3 · List the marks are now in different states: Existing, Client wish, and Vendor added if you placed FE2. In Survey every mark is Existing, so this filter is not shown there. Tap State ▾.

tour.vendor.8.body.en: Tap Client wish: the List keeps only the two wishes, FW1 and FE1. All shows every mark again.

tour.vendor.9.body.en: With one state picked, Move 2 ▸ moves every listed mark on at once, here the two wishes to Vendor review. It shows only where a move exists, so never in Survey or Estimation. The tour does not press it.

tour.vendor.line.en: Move to Vendor review, see the wishes become trades and vendor packs, place a vendor's mark, filter by state and export for one vendor.

tour.wish.1.body.en: The tour has opened Demo flat interiors, the practice project; everything goes back at the end. Wishes start in the Wish list phase: tap Wish list.

tour.wish.10.body.en: The Mark sheet shows FW1 as Existing. Tap → Client wish: the client wants something done to it.

tour.wish.11.body.en: Pick what the client wants: ↻ Replace, ⇢ Shift, ⚒ Repair or ✕ Remove. The four appear once → Client wish is tapped.

tour.wish.12.body.en: Tap Done: FW1 becomes a client wish with that act.

tour.wish.13.body.en: After Done, FW1 is drawn dashed with a Client wish tag and its act: the vendors see what the client wants done to it. (Pressed Next instead? Then it is still Existing.) Everything the tour changed goes back when it ends.

tour.wish.2.body.en: The Wish list chip has appeared. Tap it to see the services the client can ask for.

tour.wish.3.body.en: The head counts the services wanted. The vendors quote against this list.

tour.wish.4.body.en: Tap Electrical works to tick it. A ticked service shows the rooms it applies to and a note; the vendor is added later, in Vendor review.

tour.wish.5.body.en: A bathroom renovation is one bundle of five parts: waterproofing, tiling, plumbing, electrical points and painting; Parts ▾ lists them. Ticked for a bathroom picked under Applies to, it ticks all five for that room, and each part can be unticked on its own.

tour.wish.6.body.en: The tour has opened the Guest Bedroom's 360. In this phase there is no 1 · Lines and no readings: every mark you place is a client wish.

tour.wish.7.body.en: Pick a type as before; the tour has picked Electric. The chip now adds as Client wish.

tour.wish.8.body.en: For practice, tap the bare wall in the lit part: the client wants a new switch board there. The point, FE2, is born a Client wish and carries a Client wish tag. The tour takes it away at the end.

tour.wish.9.body.en: To change something already in the room, tap its code. The tour has selected FW1, the window that is there now.

tour.wish.line.en: Move to the Wish list phase, tick the services and the bathroom bundle, place a client wish, then turn an existing mark into one.
